class.name: CgameMassEntity
class.brief_description: Archetype-based, data-oriented entity storage with generational ids and ordered processors.
class.description: A MassEntity-style runtime. Entities are rows in archetypes: one archetype per distinct set of fragment names, each fragment stored as a structure-of-arrays column. Supported fragment types are [constant TYPE_PACKED_VECTOR3_ARRAY] (value [Vector3]), [constant TYPE_PACKED_FLOAT32_ARRAY] (value [float]) and [constant TYPE_PACKED_INT32_ARRAY] (value [int]). Fragments must be defined with [method define_fragment] before use. Entity ids are [int] values that pack a slot index (24 bits) and a generation, so an id of a destroyed entity never becomes valid again even when its slot is reused. Destroying swaps the last row into the freed row, keeping every archetype dense. Processors run in dependency order from [method run]. A processor is either a [Callable] receiving [code](chunk: Dictionary, count: int, delta: float)[/code] for every non-empty archetype that has all required fragments, or a built-in native processor ([method add_integrate_processor], [method add_crowd_avoidance_processor]) that avoids per-entity script calls. The chunk dictionary holds one packed array per fragment (keyed by fragment name), [code]"_ids"[/code] (slot per row) and [code]"_count"[/code]. Arrays a script processor replaces or modifies inside [code]chunk[/code] are written back after the call. Within [method run], entities cannot be created or destroyed and processors cannot be added or removed. [codeblock] var world = CgameMassEntity.new() world.define_fragment("pos", TYPE_PACKED_VECTOR3_ARRAY) world.define_fragment("vel", TYPE_PACKED_VECTOR3_ARRAY) var id = world.create({"pos": Vector3.ZERO, "vel": Vector3(1, 0, 0)}) world.add_integrate_processor("move", "pos", "vel") world.run(0.1) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_crowd_avoidance_processor
method.description: Adds a built-in native processor that runs [CgameCrowdAvoidance] over every entity having the three fragments, across all archetypes at once, and overwrites the velocity fragment with the avoidance result. All three fragments must be defined as [PackedVector3Array] fragments and be distinct. With [param ground_xz] the crowd moves in the X/Z plane and the Y component is left untouched; otherwise it uses the X/Y plane. The [code]delta[/code] passed to [method run] is used as the simulation time step.

method.name: add_integrate_processor
method.description: Adds a built-in native processor that does [code]position += velocity * delta[/code] for every entity having both fragments. Both fragments must be defined as [PackedVector3Array] fragments.

method.name: add_processor
method.description: Registers a script processor. [param callable] is invoked as [code]callable.call(chunk, count, delta)[/code] once per non-empty archetype that has every fragment in [param required]. Processors listed in [param depends_on] run first; unknown names are ignored and a dependency cycle prints an error and falls back to registration order. An empty or duplicate [param name] is rejected. [param parallel] is accepted for compatibility with the GDScript implementation and is currently ignored: script callables always run on the calling thread.

method.name: archetype_count
method.description: Returns the number of archetypes created so far. Archetypes persist after their last entity is destroyed.

method.name: clear
method.description: Destroys every entity. Fragment definitions, archetypes and processors are kept, and all previously issued ids become invalid.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates an entity whose fragments are the keys of [param fragments], with the given values, and returns its id. Returns [code]-1[/code] (and prints an error) if a key is not a defined fragment or a value has the wrong type. [Vector3] is required for vector fragments, [int] or [float] for float fragments and [int] for integer fragments. The order of keys does not matter.

method.name: create_many
method.description: Creates [param count] entities that all start with the same [param fragments] values and returns their ids. Much cheaper than calling [method create] in a loop. Returns an empty array on error.

method.name: define_fragment
method.description: Defines the fragment [param name]. [param type] must be [constant TYPE_PACKED_VECTOR3_ARRAY], [constant TYPE_PACKED_FLOAT32_ARRAY] or [constant TYPE_PACKED_INT32_ARRAY]. Redefining with the same type is a no-op; a different type is an error.

method.name: destroy
method.description: Destroys the entity. Ids that are dead or stale are ignored, so destroying twice is safe. The last row of the archetype is moved into the freed row.

method.name: entity_count
method.description: Returns the number of living entities.

method.name: get_column
method.description: Returns a copy of one fragment concatenated over all archetypes that have it, as the matching packed array. The row order equals the order of [method get_entity_ids] called with just this fragment as the requirement. Returns [code]null[/code] for an undefined fragment.

method.name: get_entity_ids
method.description: Returns the ids of all entities that have every fragment in [param required], in archetype creation order and row order.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the entity's value for [param fragment], or [code]null[/code] if the id is not alive or the entity lacks the fragment.

method.name: has_fragment
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the entity is alive and has [param fragment].

method.name: is_alive
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param id] refers to a living entity of the current generation.

method.name: processor_order
method.description: Returns processor names in execution order (stable topological order by dependencies, then registration order).

method.name: query
method.description: Returns one chunk dictionary per non-empty archetype that has every fragment in [param required]. A chunk contains the fragment arrays by name plus [code]"_ids"[/code] and [code]"_count"[/code]. The arrays are snapshots: writing into them does not change the world. Use [method set_value] or a processor to modify data.

method.name: remove_processor
method.description: Removes the processor with this name, if any.

method.name: run
method.description: Runs all processors once in dependency order. Not re-entrant.

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets the entity's value for [param fragment]. Does nothing if the id is not alive or the entity lacks the fragment; a value of the wrong type prints an error.
